methods.label: Expand the binary place values
methods.explanation:
In base two, moving one place to the left doubles the place value. Thus the five places, from right to left, have values \(1,2,4,8,16\). Applying these values to the digits gives
\[
(10011)_2
=1\cdot16+0\cdot8+0\cdot4+1\cdot2+1\cdot1
=19.
\]
The decimal numeral is \(19\), choice A.
methods.levelReason: Repeated doubling and positional notation give the conversion using elementary arithmetic.
